notes: (1) Pinned-stage ambiguity: B3/B5/B6 fullpage captures are hero frame, then many screen-heights of perfectly flat colour, then footer. TESTED: those regions compress to ~4KB and render as uniform colour, containing no faint content - the signature of a sticky scroll-scrubbed stage where the fullpage capture renders the pinned frame once and leaves scroll-spacer blank. Treated as capture artifact, not penalized. But it means only ONE composed act state is visible for each, which SUPPRESSED continuity confidence - B6 especially. If any void is actually dead space in the live page, B3/B5/B6 would all drop sharply. (2) Conversely B1/B2/B4 render act content inline so more of their pages is verifiable, but their inter-act gaps are DEMONSTRABLY REAL empty regions - a genuine asymmetry in what the evidence supports for each group. (3) Dimension 1 is partly inferential from stills: judged centrality from whether the graphical system occupies the page's ground plane and whether act chrome is bound to it, since the system cannot be observed responding. B5's continuity 4 rests on act naming plus two visibly different sky states rather than on seeing transitions, and is the single score I would most want a live pass to confirm. No build unassessable; B6 came closest.
